digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate T1 (overlay-priorart), provider capability routing
propositions: T1 (a blocking plan-review criterion) lost server-side web-search grounding after Bedrock cutover because the provider name 'bedrock:...' does not match the prefix gate 'resolved.startswith("anthropic")', silently withholding a declared capability
The prefix-matching gate contradicts the epic's zero-exceptions rule requiring capability decisions to derive from registry membership, not provider-name shape
Silent withdrawal created unobservable quality loss: T1 now blocks on weaker codebase-only evidence for plans crossing bright-line triggers, with no signal in the signed verdict
Bedrock's Converse API does not expose the native Anthropic server-side web_search tool (measured by supported_native_tools inspection), so T1 must be served by a local fallback route on Bedrock

The provider-side-only design (avoiding rebar-owned HTTP fetch) must be replaced by provider-agnostic capability routing: native where available (native tool instance), local fallback (duckduckgo with max_results=5) where native is absent
Future silent withdrawals must be prevented by recording web-access state ('native'|'local'|'off') in provider_provenance.capabilities and asserting it is observable in every signed verdict
